meanings.note: Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to forget', paired with 'забывать'.

examples.trans: Don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Сейчас будешь чинить трубу. И унитаз не забудь помыть.

meanings.en: to count on, to rely on
meanings.note: рассчитывать на + accusative: я на тебя рассчитываю = I'm counting on you
Prefix 'рас-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'считывать').

examples.trans: And without your forty I've only got a hundred and ten. I was counting on your money.
